shortDescription: MARKHAM, Ontario, Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sienna Senior Living Inc. ("Sienna" or the "Company") TSX:SIA announced today that it has completed its previously disclosed $170.7 million acquisition of Stonemont On the Park (“Stonemont”), a 305-suite retirement residence in Ottawa, Ontario.Sto…

children: announced today that it has completed its previously disclosed $170.7 million acquisition of Stonemont On the Park (“
”), a 305-suite retirement residence in Ottawa, Ontario.

Stonemont is a newly built, nearly 100% occupied retirement residence that opened in 2024. It offers a broad range of senior living and care options, from fully independent seniors’ apartments to supportive and assisted living with enhanced care services. The transaction includes an additional $10.0 million earnout contingent upon exceeding certain financial targets.
Sienna financed the acquisition with available cash on hand.

“The addition of Stonemont highlights the quality and scale of the opportunities available to us as we continue to grow our Company,” said Nitin Jain, President and Chief Executive Officer. “Since the beginning of 2025, we have added approximately $1.2 billion in assets through acquisitions and developments, with each addition reflecting our strategy of expanding in attractive markets and complementing our growing platform with high-quality assets.”

Sienna's approximately 15,500 employees are passionate about cultivating happiness in daily life. For more information, please visit www.siennaliving.ca.
